caption: The drawing shows a full-body figure of a person standing upright on a circular light brown stand, which supports them with a vertical post that is placed between their legs. The person is wearing a tan, double-breasted jacket with large cuffs and three visible buttons along the right side. The pants are dark green and loose-fitting. The figure's shoes are black, and they have tan socks with a red band near the top. The person’s head is turned slightly to the left, and they wear a black head covering that wraps around under the chin, with a small red detail on the right side. The person’s face is pale with defined features and dark, short hair visible below the hat. On the left side of the drawing, there is a faint pencil outline of the same figure viewed from behind, showing the back of the outfit and the support stand. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and in the lower right corner, there is handwritten text that reads: “Federal Art Project, WPA of VA. By Mary Humes.”
title: Doll and Costume
